_doc: Choke-point inventory (see docs/00-investigation.md section 3). approx=true means the position is approximate and still has to be checked by hand.

properties.name: Croix de Bettembourg
properties.notes: Split between Lux-City-bound (A3) and Esch/Belval-bound (A13) flows; Saarland A13 flow crosses here. Being rebuilt as part of the A3 2x3 works (to 2030).

properties.name: Echangeur Livange
properties.notes: New interchange (lot B2) under construction; full closures happen on weekends (e.g. 30 Oct-2 Nov 2026).

properties.name: Echangeur Dudelange
properties.notes: Reorganised with the A3 widening; future P&R nearby.

properties.name: A31/A3 border section (Zoufftgen)
properties.notes: Position snapped to the TomTom route at the border latitude. Lowest-capacity section on the motorway corridor. A31bis north (Richemont-border, tolled) planned ~2031.

properties.name: A31 Thionville junctions (Beauregard-Linkling-Terville-Metzange)
properties.notes: Position snapped to the A31 near Terville; the four junctions span several km. Thionville traffic merges into an A31 already loaded from Metz. AU66 Beauregard: 83k veh/day, 12% HGV.

properties.name: Thionville Moselle crossings
properties.notes: Few crossings of the Moselle; trip ends on the Thionville side.

properties.name: Echangeur Burange
properties.notes: Where the Volmerange/Dudelange route rejoins A13.

properties.name: Raemerich
properties.notes: Last bottleneck before Belval; traffic to Belvaux/Esch routed via Raemerich and Belval-Université.

properties.name: Jonction Esch / Foetz
properties.notes: A4 Esch-Luxembourg meets the Collectrice du Sud.

properties.name: Audun-le-Tiche crossing
properties.notes: ~25,000 vehicles/day through town (local official). N4 Audun-Esch closed 13 Apr-24 May 2026.

properties.name: Micheville link
properties.notes: Built to take load off Audun-le-Tiche and Esch.

properties.name: Croix de Gasperich
properties.notes: Upstream bottleneck for Lux-City-bound flows; its queues spill back down the A3 towards the border.
